welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.content: # RPC Extension (Fork of [Discord.js RPC](https://github.com/discordjs/RPC)) Rewritten from CommonJS to native ES Modules. Includes extra features not available in original Discord.js RPC, such as `type`, `largeImageUrl`, `smallImageUrl`, `stateUrl`, and `detailsUrl`. ## [Documentation](https://discord.js.org/#/docs/rpc/) ## [Rich Presence Example](https://github.com/NyrrCly/RPC-NyrrCly/tree/master/example) ## __Browser__ Example ```javascript const clientId = '287406016902594560'; const scopes = ['rpc', 'rpc.api', 'messages.read']; const client = new RPC.Client({ transport: 'websocket' }); client.on('ready', () => { console.log('Logged in as', client.application.name); console.log('Authed for user', client.user.username); client.selectVoiceChannel('81384788862181376'); }); // Log in to RPC with client id client.login({ clientId, scopes }); ```

methods.name: setUserVoiceSettings
methods.description: Set the voice settings for a user, by id

params.name: id

returns.description: A promise that resolves when the user voice settings are set.

methods.name: selectVoiceChannel
methods.description: Move the user to a voice channel

params.name: options.force
params.description:
Force this move. This should only be done if you
have explicit permission from the user.

returns.description: A promise that resolves with the selected channel.

methods.name: selectTextChannel
methods.description: Move the user to a text channel

params.name: options.timeout
params.description:
Timeout for the command
have explicit permission from the user.

returns.description: A promise that resolves with the selected channel.

methods.name: getVoiceSettings
methods.description: Get current voice settings

returns.description: A promise that resolves with the voice settings.

methods.name: setVoiceSettings
methods.description:
Set current voice settings, overriding the current settings until this session disconnects.
This also locks the settings for any other rpc sessions which may be connected.

returns.description: A promise that resolves when the voice settings are set.

methods.name: captureShortcut
methods.description:
Capture a shortcut using the client
The callback takes (key, stop) where `stop` is a function that will stop capturing.
This `stop` function must be called before disconnecting or else the user will have
to restart their client.

returns.description: A promise that resolves with a function to stop capturing.

methods.name: setActivity
methods.description: Sets the presence for the logged in user.

params.name: pid
params.description: The application's process ID. Defaults to the executing process' PID.

returns.description: A promise that resolves with the set activity.

methods.name: clearActivity
methods.description:
Clears the currently set presence, if any. This will hide the "Playing X" message
displayed below the user's name.

params.name: pid
params.description: The application's process ID. Defaults to the executing process' PID.

returns.description: A promise that resolves when the activity is cleared.
